name: Ashby
description: Connect Ashby to Claude to get instant access to your ATS data including pipeline, candidate profiles, open roles, and applications. Ask questions, dig into hiring data, and take action by adding notes, moving stages, or sending emails directly from the conversation. Ashby connects Claude to your live recruiting data through secure user-level OAuth. Every request and action respects your existing permissions and your data stays protected.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Ashby to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Ashby to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.ashbyhq.com/mcp/v1. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Ashby MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ashby lists 16 MCP tools, including describe_object_fields, filter_records, search_records_by_name, get_record_details, get_candidate, get_interview_plan, get_interview_details, get_job_pipeline, get_pending_tasks, get_submitted_feedback, get_upcoming_interviews, and search_product_docs.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Ashby?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Ashby in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Ashby requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Ashby is developed by Ashby. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
